info.title: GOLDEN ERP API
info.description: Multi-tenant SaaS ERP. All tenant endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`; unsafe operations accept `Idempotency-Key`.

post.summary: Offline sync: batch of field operations; each op is atomic and idempotent by clientId
post.description: Every op runs in its own transaction. Re-sending an op with the same clientId returns the original result (`replayed: true`) and never duplicates an invoice or receipt. Failed ops are not recorded and can be retried after fixing.
